source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing moves the existing close/minimize container to be a sibling of hidden branding in the production header and its 16 fixtures. EmailAutoForm also explicitly requests branding through the checked step-to-header method chain. The move removes only the branding ancestor's gate: refresh still hides closeButton on first run, and the retained first-run test expects that state. Do not read the commit's always-present wording as proof that both buttons are visible in every state. IDs, handlers and localized titles remain scoped source contracts; no rendering, keyboard or accessible-tree result was run.
title: Account Hub controls leave the branding container while the first-run close gate remains
